tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + Lucide React + Radix UI / Shadcn

sticky_header.description: Sticky top bar with cyan/blue gradient line bottom border on #0E1525 background
elements: Brand Logo & Title: Anclora CleanSheet with cyan accent icon
Theme Switcher: Circular toggle button (Dark / Light / System)
Auth Action Button: Sign In / User Profile menu

upload_zone.description: Interactive Drag & Drop area supporting CSV / XLSX files
features: Sheet selection selector dropdown when multi-sheet XLSX uploaded
Sample dataset quick-loader pills (ERP Export, Bank Statement, CRM Leads)
Structure fingerprint indicator showing initial row/column counts

before_after_comparison_grid.desktop_layout: Split view (Side-by-side or Top/Bottom toggle) with cell diff highlights
before_after_comparison_grid.mobile_layout: Tabbed view [ Antes / Before ] vs [ Después / After ]

interactive_rules_panel.description: Side panel or bottom panel with real-time recalculation (300ms debounce)
rule_groups: Header & Title Row Trimming (detect multi-level headers, skip title banners)
Date Standardization (propose YYYY-MM-DD, warn on ambiguous dates)
Number & Separator Normalization (decimal vs thousands separator cleanup)
Column Renaming & Case Controls (disabled by default per conservative preset)

recipe_exporter_and_manager.description: Export clean data or export reproducible logic

execution_history.description: Log of past cleanings with audit details, original filenames, timestamps, and confidence scores

hero_analytics_screen.description: Data analytics and spreadsheet monitoring screen

dashboard_data_sheet.description: Clean modern data table interface representation

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All React code MUST be in .js / .jsx format (do not use TypeScript .tsx files).

Ensure ALL interactive elements and data indicators include concise, kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='lang-toggle-pill', data-testid='rule-toggle-date-format', data-testid='confidence-badge').

Follow the Conservative Hybrid Preset defaults: auto-detect regional formats, date formats, decimal separators, but present them as reviewable proposals. Do not auto-rename or convert column names to snake_case unless explicitly toggled by user.
Maintain high visual density for data grids with tabular-nums font features, compact padding (px-3 py-2), sticky header columns, and dark mode palette defaults (#080D18, #0B1220, #0E1525).
Provide responsive split view for desktop and full tab switching for mobile in the Before/After comparison grid.
Implement real-time debounced recalculation (300ms) when toggling cleaning rules in the Rules Panel.
Provide modal dialogs for YAML and Python script export with copy-to-clipboard and file download triggers.
Include sample data pre-loads so users can immediately test cleaning without needing an initial CSV file on hand.
In the header bar, ensure the sticky bar background is #0E1525 with a distinct bottom border gradient utilizing #3B82F6 and #38BDF8.
Include both English (EN) and Spanish (ES) internationalization strings throughout all UI components.
